name: Double-calm gate (calm VIX + low realized-vol) under risk-on macro arms BB-z washout
rationale: THESIS: require BOTH a TradFi calm (vix_level lt) AND a crypto-native calm (vol_realized lt) under a risk-on macro_regime before arming a bb_z washout long. The two calms are different lenses (implied equity vol vs realized crypto vol); requiring both isolates dislocations that are idiosyncratic/technical (single asset washed out while the tape is quiet) — the cleanest reversion setup — from broad risk-off. DISCONFIRMER 1 (does the second calm add?): spec-1 (macro/vix gate + bb_z, NO realized-vol) is the baseline; if vol_realized adds no risk-adjusted return it only cost trades. DISCONFIRMER 2 (is vol_realized just restating vix?): a sibling that swaps vix for vol_realized (crypto-calm only) tests whether the two calms are redundant. DISCONFIRMER 3 (just buy-the-quiet-washout?): the inbox bollinger-z-score-washout-reversion already pairs bb_z with vol_realized ungated by macro — that is the direct ungated control. DISCONFIRMER 4 (holdout).
catalyst: bb_z washout while vix calm, vol_realized low, macro risk-on
